description: Defines the InputMetadata struct used for recording tensor options, shape, and other metadata in PyTorch's autograd system.

classes.name: InputMetadata
classes.description: A struct that records tensor options, shape, and other metadata for autograd operations.

methods.name: InputMetadata()
methods.description: Default constructor for InputMetadata.

methods.description: Returns the tensor options.
